correctness.rationale: The deterministic tree comparison controls all birth-label pair distances by height-difference error Δ_N(μ) plus longest two-step zero-run length M_N. Kemeny–Wiener identity κ=2W/(N−1)−N+1/2 gives |κ/N²−1/(3μ)|≤(1+2Δ_N+2M_N)/N. Uniform depth concentration via independent backward jumps and geometric zero-run estimates prove regimes p_N→p>0, p_N→0 with Np_N→∞, and with Np_N→0. One immediately-prior attachment at k yields tripod arm lengths a=k−1,b=ceil((N−k)/2),c=floor((N−k)/2), κpath−κ=2abc/(N−1), verified independently via BFS/edge cuts for N≤10. At Np_N→λ, no and exactly-one-bridge events have limiting probabilities e^−λ, λe^−λ and different random limits, refuting deterministic convergence. Fixed-p a.s. claim requires fixed nested Bernoulli coupling. Entire critical law is not asserted.
